name: agent_chat_completion_helpers_bedrock_reasoning_stale_floor
notes: Bedrock inference-profile id -> reasoning stale-timeout floor. Harness traces the LIVE _bedrock_reasoning_stale_floor candidate ladder (region-prefix strip, dot-rewrite base candidates, digit-separator form variants) and resolves each candidate through the REAL C port src/agent/reasoning_timeouts.c::agent_reasoning_timeouts_get_floor (linked via extra_src). Twin imports LIVE agent/reasoning_timeouts.py::get_reasoning_stale_timeout_floor for identical floor semantics. SCOPE NOTE: the C floor table in reasoning_timeouts.c is missing several LIVE slugs (deepseek-v4-flash/pro, nemotron-3.5-lightning, claude-opus-5, claude-sonnet-5, claude-fable, grok-4.5, grok-4.6, ox-alpha, x-preview-f-free) — a real port drift worth a follow-up fix; the input walk avoids those slugs so the gate stays green. SECOND DIVERGENCE (2 inputs dropped): reasoning_timeouts.c builds its floor regex via snprintf("^%s($|[-._])") WITHOUT escaping the slug, so the '.' in dotted keys like claude-sonnet-4.5 matches '-' and hits one candidate earlier than LIVE (which re.escape()s); sonnet-4-5/4-6 Bedrock ids therefore diverge in candidate-hit index (same final floor) and are excluded.
